services.name: Amazon RDS Multi-AZ
services.why: Synchronous standby for failover; the DB instance standby does not serve read traffic.

services.name: RDS read replica
services.why: Asynchronous read-only endpoint to offload read-heavy queries; replication lag is possible.

services.name: Amazon Aurora
services.why: Cluster storage with separate writer/reader endpoints; compare compatible engine behavior and cost with RDS.

services.name: DynamoDB Streams
services.why: Ordered item-change records can invoke a Lambda event source mapping for downstream processing.

services.name: CloudWatch / CloudTrail / Config
services.why: Metrics and logs / account API history / supported resource configuration history and rules.

services.name: Systems Manager / KMS / WAF / Shield
services.why: Parameter Store and Session Manager / encryption keys / web ACL at CloudFront or ALB / Shield Standard baseline DDoS protection.
